description: Call this whenever you're about to recommend, link to or buy a part, accessory, charger, filter, cartridge, lens, battery, memory, mount or adapter for something the person already owns, or they ask "will X work with Y" / "is this compatible". Pass both exact models. Covers anything that has to fit, plug in, mount, run on or charge with something someone owns (list_coverage shows the verified catalog). Returns a decision (supported / conditional / incompatible / insufficient_evidence), the rules checked, caveats, required accessories, the questions to ask when it can't decide, evidence links and a signed receipt. When the text matches several models it returns each candidate's answer.

candidate.description: What they want to buy: a model/part number or key specs, e.g. 'Crucial CT16G4SFRA32A', '1TB M.2 2230 NVMe', 'DCB205', 'HP 962XL', 'Canon RF 24-105mm f/4L', 'Eve Energy'.

candidate_id.description: Optional: an exact product id instead of candidate text.

detail.description: Optional extra identifiers: machine type, revision, year, region, serial range.

existing.description: What the person already has, ideally with the exact model number, e.g. 'Lenovo ThinkPad T480', 'Sony A7 IV', 'DeWalt DCD800', 'HP OfficeJet Pro 9015e', 'iPhone 16 Pro', 'HomePod mini'.

existing_id.description: Optional: an exact product id (from resolve_product, suggestions or a candidates list) instead of existing text.

name: check_compatibility
title: Check compatibility
